name: KiCad Assembly & Fabrication Tool
description: Customizable Assembly (BOM, Pick & Place / CPL) file generator for KiCad 10 with custom vendor templates and Pick & Place machine presets.
description_full: A comprehensive KiCad 10 assembly and fabrication plugin. Generates customized BOM and Pick & Place (CPL) files with custom vendor column templates, PnP machine presets (NeoDen, Charmhigh, LitePlacer, JLCPCB, PCBWay), multi-format export (CSV, XLSX, ZIP), and Fiducial origin alignment.
